body.x: A Virtual Co., Ltd. (CEO Kim Taejun) announced its participation in CES 2024, to be held in Las Vegas, United States, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday) local time.

A Virtual specializing in 5G advanced materials for air and water purification and renewable energy aims to build a sustainable future. A company official stated, “Our 5G advanced nano-materials are a dream technology applicable to air, water, and energy,” adding, “We’ve launched a unique solution in the air sterilization sector, effectively removing various harmful substances like viruses, bacteria, and VOCs from the air in the global market.” Recognized for its proprietary technology, A Virtual’s ‘Safe-Air Modular solution’ has participated in the South Korean President’s economic delegation for five consecutive sessions and is preparing to expand into Saudi Arabia.

The Safe-Air Modular solution is a technology utilizing next-generation nano-semiconductor materials leading the eco-friendly energy industry, applicable across various sectors such as air sterilization, water purification, and energy efficiency. A Virtual applied this to develop a fourth-generation sterilization filter and modularized it to produce the flagship product, A-WEAR air purification sterilizer, which was completed for development and export. According to officials, it can eliminate viruses, bacteria, and VOCs in spaces including households, theaters, department stores, hospitals, and offices by 99% in real-time.

In particular, A Virtual established a Dubai branch as its primary target in the Middle East and completed the initial shipment of A-WEAR products in November 2023. Through a secondary MOU in Saudi Arabia, discussions for expansion across Saudi Arabia, Africa, and the Middle East are ongoing. In the United States, A Virtual conducts technological verifications through local tests with local buyers and partner companies using modules and air purification sterilizer products.

The company is discussing collaboration through open innovation with major domestic companies to apply modules to air cleaners, air conditioners, refrigerators, and clothing care machines, among others.

body.x: An official stated, “We plan to brand our flagship A-WEAR product for mass exports and apply the Safe-Air module used internally in the mobility market, buildings, medical institutions, and other areas requiring air purification and sterilization in OEM format. Furthermore, we aim to enhance this technology to offer applications in various industries, including air sterilization and water purification, renewable energy efficiency, and more.”

They added, “At CES this year, A Virtual aims to address healthcare issues and contribute to human security and sustainability by presenting our unique technology, Safe-Air Modular solution. Through collaboration with 4th Industrial Revolution technologies from electronic and home appliance companies closely related to daily life, we aim to evolve into a global air solution specialist,” expressing their goal to enhance corporate competitiveness and introduce A Virtual’s innovative Safe-Air solution to overseas companies by establishing global partnerships and export contracts through participation in CES 2024.

The Consumer Technology Association (CTA) hosts CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition held annually in Las Vegas, USA, allowing visitors to grasp global trends in the home appliance industry at a glance.
